market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Susan Collins has a strong personal brand, outperforming Trump by ~18 points in 2020 in a state Trump lost. She is likely to run again (no retirement signals), and even in a midterm with potential headwinds, her win probability is much higher than the market’s 22.5%. If she retires, Republican chances drop, but overall probability likely exceeds 50%.
evidence_points: Collins won re-election in 2020 by 8.6% while Trump lost Maine by 9%, showing strong crossover appeal.
No public indication of retirement; incumbents of her stature rarely step down without major cause.
Maine has a history of electing moderate Republicans (e.g., Snowe, Collins) even in Democratic-leaning years.
sources_consulted: National polling and midterm dynamics analysis
